references.text: The priest examines again and considers whether the plague has spread, a recurring pattern in the law of leprosy
Parallel text about the priest's examination of whether the plague has spread in garments or skins
Introduces the laws concerning leprosy in garments, including warp, weft, and leather items
Further instructions on what should be done with garments and leather items affected by leprosy
Similar procedure where the priest examines whether the plague has spread, here in connection with houses
